node.statement: The scalar ledger in def-routef-raw-factor-setting gives C_T=C_theta+3*C_V and rho_T<=min{[4*(1+C_theta)]^(-1),[4*(1+C_V)]^(-1)}. Here C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1)>=0 and C_V=max{1,C_E}*C_A>=0 by lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation. Hence eta<=rho_T implies C_theta*eta<=1/4 and C_V*eta<=1/4, so C_T*eta<=1 and therefore 1+C_T*eta<=2.
